title: DC-area forecast: Comfortable tonight as humidity slowly rises for a warmer Wednesday
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Another pleasant evening with temperatures falling into and through the 70s.

What’s next? Still pretty nice Wednesday even though a touch warmer and more humid. Noticeably more humid Thursday and Friday as shower and storm chances return.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Clear and mostly comfortable with lows from the upper 50s in the outer suburbs, to the mid-60s closer to and inside the Beltway. Winds are very light to calm. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Wednesday): Winds shifting to come from the south bring back a touch of heat and humidity. But it's still relatively comfortable, with highs in the mid- to upper 80s and dew points in the low 60s. Slight chance of a late-afternoon shower. Confidence: High

Tomorrow night: Partly to mostly cloudy with an isolated evening shower possible, then a better chance of a few showers and storms overnight. Mugginess builds with lows in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium-High

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Thursday looks to be more unsettled as skies range from partly sunny to mostly cloudy. Isolated to scattered showers are possible in the morning, with a decent chance of scattered showers and thunderstorms during the afternoon into evening. Highs are in the mid- to upper 80s, but feel more like the low 90s thanks to moderate to high humidity (dew points lift to near or above 70). Shower and storm chances continue Thursday night with muggy lows in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium-High

Friday finds a cool front stalling toward our southern and eastern areas. If the front stays close enough, then we could see a continued chance for some scattered showers and storms, especially south and east of DC. With lingering clouds and at least moderate humidity, highs hit the mid- to upper 80s again. Friday night tries to cool a bit with lows from the mid-60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium

The final weekend of August and meteorological summer (wow!) looks fairly reasonable for summer standards. Skies should be partly to sometimes mostly sunny with highs still in the mid- to upper 80s. Humidity may edge a bit lower, but it's probably still up near the moderate range, with only a small chance of a shower as of now. Partly cloudy Saturday night with lows in the mid-60s to near 70. Confidence: Medium

Early next week takes us into September with some hotter highs up into the low to perhaps mid-90s, before a midweek cold front brings shower and storm chances, followed by cooler highs in the 80s by late week.

The tornado that saved Washington

A violent 1814 storm—likely including a tornado—ripped through Washington, damaging buildings, dousing fires, and helping drive British troops from the city during the War of 1812.

Today’s daily digit — 9/10: We fluff up the digit with all the good stuff (sunshine, low humidity, warmth) without all that bad stuff (sweat, stickiness, and severe weather). | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
